experiments.name: Kafka queue feeding PostgreSQL
experiments.title: Kafka: Node.js producer, 6 partitions, 3 consumers inserting into PostgreSQL
experiments.caveat: Every Kafka run so far was measured with a broker healthcheck that started a Java tool every 3 s on the broker's own core (about half a core, all the time). Without it the same stack held the objective up to about 3,000 req/s in a trial on 31 Oct, so these measured knees are the benchmark's limit, not Kafka's. The healthcheck is fixed in compose.yaml; the next campaign measures Kafka again.
